history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send a picture message. Can you help me fix it?

I'm here to help! To assist you better, could you please provide your phone number or the name on your account? This will help me check your line status and identify any issues that might be causing the loss of service.

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send messages or use data.

Would you like me to resume your line so you can regain service? If you know the reason for the suspension or if it was a mistake, please let me know.
I didn't know my line was suspended. Can you please resume it so I can get my service back?

I’m unable to resume your line because your contract ended on November 30, 2024. This is likely why your service was suspended.

To restore your service, you may need to renew your contract or select a new plan. Would you like information on renewing your contract or choosing a new plan? I can guide you through the next steps.
